defects.description: A title amendment recomputes standard weight using the title's inferred category ahead of the passenger's recorded category, changing an adult's planning weight to a child's.

trigger.input: Add a passenger with title Mr and category adult, then amend only title to Mstr and read the profile.

defects.why_missed: The suite registers profiles and amends itineraries; it never supplies a title amendment. Changing a registration literal does not invoke the amendment's recomputation path.

defects.description: Amendment merges the stored representation instead of the decoded profile. Positional records become objects with numeric properties and lose their named fields on the next read.

trigger.input: Use a store containing a positional passenger record; add a second named record through the register, read both, amend only the first destination, then read both again.
trigger.expected: The positional passenger retains name, title, category and weight with the new destination; the named passenger is unchanged.
trigger.actual: The amended passenger has numeric properties instead of named profile fields; the second passenger is unchanged.

defects.why_missed: The suite uses only the default empty store and API-created named records. No positional-record fixture or store helper is present.
